text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of boys and girls who have completed primary school
The share of boys and girls who are three to five years older than the official age for the last grade of primary
education who have successfully completed it. This broader age band is used to include children who started
school late or had to resit particular years.
